requirements.requirement: Perform demolition and abatement services at specified VA Medical Centers.
requirements.source_quote: This Statement of Work (SOW) is for an IDC for demolition and abatement efforts supporting construction and repair services at VANJHCS Medical Centers.

requirements.requirement: Provide services on an as needed basis for a five-year term.
requirements.source_quote: These services shall be provided on an as needed basis, for a five-year term.

requirements.requirement: Provide all labor, materials, equipment, tools, transportation, supervision, safety, quality control, and management necessary for task orders.
requirements.source_quote: The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, tools, transportation, supervision, safety, quality control and management necessary to fulfill the requirements of task orders.

requirements.requirement: Comply with applicable Infection Control requirements and New Jersey Administrative Code.
requirements.source_quote: All work completed under this contract shall comply with applicable Infection Control requirements and the New Jersey Administrative Code.

requirements.requirement: Obtain written authorization from the Contracting Officer for any work outside the defined SOW.
requirements.source_quote: No work outside the defined Statement of Work (SOW) shall be performed without written authorization from the Contracting Officer.

requirements.requirement: Ensure all work is performed in a safe, compliant, and professional manner.
requirements.source_quote: The Contractor shall be responsible for all means and methods and shall ensure all work is performed in a safe, compliant, and professional manner.

requirements.requirement: Submit proposals by October 16th, 2026 at 10:00 EST.
requirements.source_quote: All proposals are due October 16th, 2026 at 10:00EST.

requirements.requirement: Email quotes to Michael Spivack at the specified email address.
requirements.source_quote: Quotes shall be emailed to Michael Spivack at Michael.Spivack@va.gov.

requirements.requirement: Register in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the close of the solicitation.
requirements.source_quote: Offerors shall be registered in the System for Award Management (www.sam.gov) at the close of the solicitation.

requirements.requirement: Submit annual Vets4212 Report.
requirements.source_quote: Offerors must submit their annual Vets4212 Report.

requirements.source_quote: Performance bonds shall be required for projects over $35,000.00 at the time of acceptance of the task order.

requirements.requirement: Submit invoices electronically in accordance with VAAR Clause 852.232-72.
requirements.source_quote: All Invoices from the contractor shall be submitted electronically in accordance with VAAR Clause 852.232-72.

requirements.source_quote: Material testing and air monitoring services required while performing asbestos removal services shall be provided by the VANJHCS at no cost to the contractor.
